source:
@@U00309@@
“In the beginning was the Deed!”
If we're to share this room, poodle,
you'll have to put an end to this howling and growling!
I can’t manage so distracting a companion.
One of us will have to leave.
And as much as I hate to be an ungracious host,
there’s the door, it’s open, you're free to go.
But what’s this?
What am I seeing?
Can it be? Is it real?
Is it an illusion?
How long and broad my poodle’s growing!
It rises a monstrosity!
This is no longer the shape of a dog!
What sort of specter have I taken in?
He’s already the size of a hippopotamus,
eyes like torches,
terrible fangs!
Ah! I know you now!
The key of Solomon’s the thing to handle you.

@@U00310@@
(SPIRITS are heard in the corridor outside.)

@@U00312@@
One we know well
Is caught fast within there.
Mind what you're doing,
No one go in there!
An old lynx of Hell,
Like a fox in a gin, there
Is quaking and stewing.
Have a care! Have a care!
Unseen, through the air,
Flit now and hover,
To and fro, round about,
Now under, now over,
translation:
@@U00309@@
“一开始就是契约！”
如果我们要共用这个房间，贵宾犬，
你必须结束这种嚎叫和咆哮！
我受不了一个如此分散注意力的同伴。
我们中的一个人将不得不离开。
尽管我讨厌成为一个不友善的主人，
门在那儿，它开着，你可以走了。
但这是什么？
我看到了什么？
可以吗？这是真的吗？
难道是幻觉？
我的贵宾犬长得多长多宽啊！
它崛起为一个怪物！
这已经不是狗的形状了！
我中了什么样的鬼魂？
他已经有河马那么大了，
眼睛像火炬一样，
可怕的獠牙！
啊!我现在认识你了！
所罗门的关键在于对付你。

@@U00310@@
（外面走廊里传来鬼魂的声音。）

@@U00312@@
一位我们熟知的
很快就被困在里面了。
注意你在做什么，
没人进去！
地狱的老山猫，
就像杜松子酒里的狐狸一样，
正在颤抖和炖煮。
保重！保重！
透过空气看不见，
现在飞翔并悬停，
来来回回，绕来绕去，
现在在下，现在结束，
